overview_description.description: Sonatype is a developer-friendly, full-spectrum software supply chain management providing organizations total control of their cloud-native development lifecycles, including third-party open-source code, first-party source code, infrastructure as code, and containerized code. The company supports 70% of the Fortune 100 and its commercial and open source tools are trusted by 15 million developers around the world. With a vision to transform the way the world innovates, Sonatype helps organizations of all sizes build higher quality software that's more aligned with business needs, more maintainable, and more secure.  Sonatype has been recognized by Fast Company as one of the Best Workplaces for Innovators in the world, two years in a row, and has been named to the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 and Inc. 5000 list for the past five years. Sonatype was established in 2008 and is based in Fulton, Maryland with offices in McLean, London, and Sydney.

about_short_description.short_description: Sonatype is the developer-friendly full-spectrum software supply chain management platform helps organizations and software developers.

product.name: Nexus One Platform
product.description: A software supply chain management platform for governing open-source software, AI components, dependencies, artifacts, vulnerabilities, malware, and compliance across the software development lifecycle.

product.name: Sonatype Lifecycle
product.description: Software composition analysis and dependency management software that identifies open-source risk, enforces policies, and supports vulnerability remediation across the software development lifecycle.

product.name: Sonatype Nexus Repository
product.description: An artifact repository manager for storing, proxying, managing, and distributing software components, container images, and AI models used in development and delivery pipelines.

product.name: Sonatype Repository Firewall
product.description: A repository security product that detects and blocks malicious, suspicious, or policy-violating open-source components and AI models before they enter development repositories.

product.name: Sonatype SBOM Manager
product.description: A software bill of materials management product for generating, importing, analyzing, governing, sharing, and reporting on SBOMs for software compliance and supply chain visibility.

product.name: Sonatype Guide
product.description: An open-source component intelligence service that provides dependency guidance and vulnerability context to developers and AI coding assistants.
